description: This file contains advanced unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler functionality, including testing task execution order, context propagation, scheduler behavior, continuation handling, and concurrency scenarios within the Orleans runtime environment.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerAdvancedTests
classes.description: A collection of advanced unit tests for Orleans task scheduler features and behaviors, including execution order, context propagation, task scheduling, continuation handling, and concurrency scenarios.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Test
methods.description: Tests serial execution of scheduled tasks, verifying they execute without concurrency issues.

methods.name: Sched_AC_WaitTest
methods.description: Tests task waiting and synchronization, ensuring tasks run as expected with proper ordering.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Turn_Execution_Order
methods.description: Verifies that the Orleans scheduler executes work items in a proper turn-by-turn sequence, even with nested or chained tasks.

methods.name: Sched_Stopped_WorkItemGroup
methods.description: Validates scheduler behavior when a WorkItemGroup is stopped, including proper task scheduling and cancellation handling.

methods.name: Sched_Task_Turn_Execution_Order
methods.description: Checks that individual tasks within the Orleans scheduler adhere to correct execution order and isolation between different task chains.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Current_TaskScheduler
methods.description: Ensures that tasks accurately report and operate on the expected current TaskScheduler within the Orleans environment.

methods.name: Sched_AC_ContinueWith_1_Test
methods.description: Tests continuation tasks chained after initial tasks, verifying correct execution and ordering.

methods.name: Sched_Task_JoinAll
methods.description: Verifies that multiple tasks scheduled in parallel complete correctly and their results are as expected.

methods.name: Sched_AC_ContinueWith_2_OrleansSched
methods.description: Tests error handling and continuation execution when initial tasks fault, within the Orleans scheduler context.

methods.name: Sched_Task_SchedulingContext
methods.description: Checks task scheduling and execution within a specific SchedulingContext, ensuring context integrity across chained tasks.
